fonts.display: 'PP Radio Grotesk', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif
fonts.body: 'Inter', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif

palette.name: Electric Cobalt
palette.role: Primary action buttons, active states, the single chromatic accent that punctuates the entire monochrome system

palette.name: Periwinkle Wash
palette.role: Light blue surface for highlighted regions, subtle brand-tinted backgrounds, soft accent fills

palette.name: Lavender Veil
palette.role: Soft violet surface for the brand mark and tertiary accent zones, a whisper of warmth against the cool palette

palette.name: Obsidian
palette.role: Neutral form states, badge text, and quiet UI feedback where color should stay understated. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

palette.name: Graphite
palette.role: Secondary text, link color, muted descriptions, supportive copy that recedes from primary content

palette.name: Stone
palette.role: Tertiary surface fills, disabled-state backgrounds, very subtle card differentiation

palette.name: Ash
palette.role: Drop shadow base at 16% opacity, secondary dividers, barely-there surface separation

palette.name: Pewter
palette.role: Secondary borders, card edges, input field outlines, the structural grid color at 1px weight

palette.name: Slate Mist
palette.role: Primary hairline borders, the most-used divider color, separating cards, sections, and table rows

palette.name: Fog
palette.role: Subtle page-surface lift, alternating section backgrounds, the barely-warm off-white that breaks pure white monotony

palette.name: Canvas
palette.role: Page background, card surfaces, text on dark fills, the dominant surface where everything sits
